newsitem.title: UK: IBCA withdraws Thorn EMI ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA withdraws Thorn EMI ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it had removed Thorn EMI Plc from RatingWatch and withdrawn its A long-term and A1 short-term ratings.

"This follows the formal demerger of Thorn EMI Plc on 19 August 1996, to form Thorn Plc, which retains the rental operations of the old group and EMI Group Plc which keeps the music production, distribution and retailing arms," IBCA said in a statement.
"Any future IBCA ratings of the new entities will depend upon the companies' individual capital structures and financing requirements," the rating agency said.
